groups.title: Routing Plan
groups.description: Choose how unmatched traffic is handled, then select the business scenarios that need dedicated outlets.
groups.base_policy_meta: Controls traffic that matches no private, direct, reject, or business rule.
groups.base_policy_proxy_desc: Direct known private and local traffic, then send unmatched traffic to PROXY for higher reachability.
groups.base_policy_direct_desc: Proxy only explicitly listed traffic and send unmatched traffic to DIRECT to save proxy usage.
groups.template_meta: Combine scenarios freely. Each one enables its dedicated policy groups and rule sets.
groups.scenario_ai_development_desc: Control outlets for AI, code hosting, developer tools, and related platform services.
groups.scenario_streaming_desc: Choose unlocking nodes or regions for Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, and similar services.
groups.scenario_communication_desc: Control one outlet for Telegram and international social services.
groups.scenario_gaming_desc: Choose gaming outlets by latency, region, or route quality.
groups.scenario_finance_desc: Choose a dedicated outlet for exchanges, wallets, and blockchain services.
groups.scenario_brokerage_desc: Choose a dedicated outlet for brokerage services such as Futu, Longbridge, Tiger, and Schwab.
groups.scenario_diagnostics_desc: Speedtest uses DIRECT by default and can switch to any node or node group.
groups.scenario_platform_desc: Control outlets for Apple, Microsoft, and Google services.
groups.effective_policy_meta: These rule sets and the final fallback will be included in exports.
groups.foundation_meta: Always present. Rules can target PROXY / DIRECT / REJECT directly, while business routing groups include foundations and node outlets automatically.
groups.foundation_rule_targets_desc: Rules can target these directly for default proxy, direct, and reject traffic.
groups.global_node_outlets_desc: Outlet candidates inside business routing groups, not direct rule targets.
groups.empty_description: Selected scenarios generate built-in policy groups automatically. Add only extra business routing groups here.
groups.auto_members_text: After saving, the system automatically includes PROXY, DIRECT, REJECT, all nodes, node selection, auto selection, fallback, and currently available country / tag node groups. Global node outlets use the default usable node pool, which excludes high-multiplier nodes by default.
groups.foundation_proxy_desc: Default proxy outlet. It aggregates rule foundations, the default usable node-pool outlets, and available node groups.
groups.foundation_direct_desc: Direct outlet. Domestic rules, LAN traffic, and traffic that should not use a proxy target this policy.
groups.foundation_reject_desc: Reject outlet. Ad, HTTPDNS, and blocking rules target this policy.
groups.foundation_all_nodes_desc: Contains the default usable node pool and excludes high-multiplier nodes by default.
groups.foundation_node_select_desc: Manually select a specific node or node group from the default usable node pool.
groups.foundation_auto_select_desc: Automatically chooses the lowest-latency node from the default usable node pool.
groups.foundation_fallback_desc: Falls back to another node from the default usable node pool when the current one fails.
groups.reorder_hint: Choose business scenarios; foundation outlets and node group candidates are maintained automatically

rules.compatibility_preview_desc: Calculated from the rule type and match value. Equivalent spelling changes are automatic; unsupported rules are omitted and reported during export.
rules.compatibility_no_resolve_omitted: This target does not support per-rule DNS resolution control, so the option is omitted.
rules.compatibility_no_resolve_implicit: No option is needed; this target does not resolve DNS solely to match this rule.
rules.reorder_hint: Default routing comes from Routing Plan and Rule Set Management; keep only manually added rules here, ordered by priority
rules.search_placeholder: Search match value, name, target, or notes...
rules.no_results_help: Try another match value, rule type, policy, or status.
rules.reorder_filtered_notice: Clear filters before changing global rule priority.
rules.select_visible_limit: Select the first {{count}} visible manual rules
rules.selection_limit_notice: One batch can update at most {{count}} manual rules. Narrow the filters to process the remaining rules safely.
rules.empty_description: Manual rules are usually unnecessary. Default routing is generated from Routing Plan and its managed rule sets.
rules.batch_help: Supports Clash line format. The target used after a match can be omitted; omitted targets use the selected target above, or PROXY when none is selected. Prefer presets in Rule Set Management for normal routing.
rules.batch_compatibility_invalid_hint: {{count}} invalid lines must be fixed or removed before saving. Compatibility counts include valid lines only.
rules.batch_issue_unknown_target: Line {{line}}: target policy “{{detail}}” does not exist or is disabled.
rules.batch_issue_more: {{count}} more invalid lines are not shown.
rules.batch_issue_fix_all: Fix or remove every invalid line before saving.

preview.transformation_desc: Only transformations with explicit semantic outcomes are shown. Rules that cannot be represented safely are never guessed or broadened.
preview.stale_after_refresh_error: The latest recheck failed. This content is kept only for comparison; recheck successfully before copying it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.data_sensitive_hint: Backups contain subscription URLs, node credentials, and public subscription tokens. Store them like passwords. Imports are validated before restore.
settings.export_sensitive_confirm: The plaintext backup contains subscription URLs, node passwords, and subscription tokens. Continue exporting?
settings.import_too_large: Backup file must not exceed {{size}} MiB.
settings.clear_confirm: Clear all data? This action cannot be undone.
settings.import_confirm: Backup v{{version}} passed validation with {{count}} rows. Import it and overwrite all current data?
settings.auto_refresh_hint: The scheduled task only refreshes remote subscriptions when they are due. A subscription-specific interval takes precedence over the default below.
settings.dns_hint: All full-config exports use FakeIP. These settings apply to full-config downloads and public subscription links; node-only subscriptions do not include DNS settings.
settings.dns_resolution_single_hint: Resolve every domain through the same local DNS upstreams.
settings.dns_resolution_split_hint: Use local upstreams for domestic domains and separate upstreams for other domains, translated to each client's native syntax.
settings.dns_real_ip_domains_hint: Separate domains with commas. QuixoticHeart's managed FakeIP exceptions are always merged automatically.
settings.dns_real_ip_domains_invalid: Enter valid domains or wildcard domains, up to 256 entries.
settings.naming_smart_desc: Country/region + source + sequence, useful for mixed subscriptions
settings.naming_original_desc: Keep names after subscription import or node-group processing
settings.auto_node_groups_enabled: Synchronize node groups by country/region and tag pools whenever nodes change
settings.auto_node_include_flag: Include flag emoji in generated country/region node group names
settings.auto_node_groups_hint: Choose exact countries/regions, tag pools, and upstream subscription groups in the Node Groups auto-generation panel.
settings.auto_node_type_url_test_desc: Generate latency-first outlet node groups by country/region and tag pool
settings.auto_node_type_select_desc: Generate manually switchable outlet node groups by country/region and tag pool
settings.auto_node_type_fallback_desc: Generate outlet node groups that fail over by country/region and tag pool
settings.show_compat_warnings_hint: Controls optional compatibility hints in previews. Required errors, such as an export that cannot be generated, are always shown.
settings.rule_set_conversion_compatible_hint: When an export profile has no override, keep every safely convertible rule and report unsupported directives.
settings.rule_set_conversion_strict_hint: When an export profile has no override, block downloads and public subscriptions if any rule would be skipped; previews still explain why.
settings.access_key_hint: If this instance is protected with an access key, you can clear the one stored in this browser and re-enter it.
settings.access_key_clear_confirm: Forget the stored access key and lock this browser? You will need to re-enter it.
